const d=$json; const first=Array.isArray(d.proposedActions)&&d.proposedActions.length?d.proposedActions[0]:null; const action=first?{action_key:first.actionKey,title:first.title,description:first.description,risk_level:first.riskLevel}:null; const totals=d.diagnostics?.totals||{}; return [{json:{ok:Boolean(d.ok&&d.reply),reply:String(d.reply||'Agent Leo could not complete the diagnostic.'),diagnosis:[`Agents: ${totals.agents??0}`,`Connected services: ${totals.integrations??0}`,`Automations: ${totals.workflows??0}`,`Recent failures: ${totals.workflowFailures??0}`],evidence:[],action,approval_required:Boolean(d.needsHumanReview||(action&&action.risk_level!=='low')),execution:{engine:'fluxknight-ai-service',connected:Boolean(d.ai?.connected),model:d.ai?.model||null,fallback_used:Boolean(d.ai?.fallbackUsed),latency_ms:d.ai?.latencyMs||null}}}];
